units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 20a:15">Kidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>הקונה ע׳ עברי וכ׳</he> he who buys a Hebrew slave, has, so to say, bought a master over himself.

<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:5">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>כלום יש ע׳ שנותן וכ׳</he> dare a servant salute his master (first)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:24">Snh. 58ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 12:11">Prov. XII, 11</cite>) <he>אם … כע׳ לאדמה וכ׳</he> if a man makes himself a slave to the soil, he will be satisfied with bread &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:3">Kidd. I, 3</cite> <he>ע׳ כנעני נקנה וכ׳</he> a Canaanite (gentile) slave is acquired by money, by deed &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:13">Ib. III, 13</cite> <he>ממזר … הולד ע׳</he> if a bastard marries a slave, the child is a slave; <he>הרי זה ע׳ ממזר</he> the child is a bastard slave (subject to the disabilities of both).
<cite ref="Shevuot 47b:6">Shebu. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ מלך כמלך</he> a king’s officer is like a king (the inferior person is raised by association with a superior); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲבָדִים</he>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 22b:5">Kidd. 22ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 25:55">Lev. XXV, 55</cite>) <he>כי לי … ולא ע׳ לע׳</he> ‘the children of Israel are my servants’, but they must not make themselves servants of servants (of human beings).

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:3">Ab. I, 3</cite> <he>אל תהיו כע׳ וכ׳</he> be not like the servants that wait upon their master for the sake of getting their fare (reward), v. <cite ref="Q01911"><he>פְּרָס</he></cite>; a. fr.
